contradictions.title: Alibi Mismatch: Priya Desai
contradictions.description: Subject claimed to be at the Bangalore Tech Summit until 23:30, but CCTV and cell tower telemetry place her at Apex Pharmaceuticals at 21:52.

contradictions.title: False Statement: Rajesh Singhania
contradictions.description: Rajesh claimed Priya never left his side at the summit, but phone records show a 3.5 hour gap in proximity.

contradictions.title: Vehicle Discrepancy
contradictions.description: Arjun's car left the garage at 22:06, but the driver's silhouette does not match Arjun's height.
